title:
Comment of Kayla Weisdorf in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15424-000
Submission Date: 9/29/2026

documents.name: 151422.txt
documents.text:
Kayla Weisdorf, New York, NY.
I am a citizen of the United States, and I want whale habitat over data centers, over surveys for those potential data centers that could harm those whales every day. Data center or meadow? MEADOW. Data center or forest? FOREST! Data center or right whale habitat? RIGHT WHALE HABITAT!! These creatures and their precious lives are more of a gift to humanity than the unwanted personal projects of a few wealthy billionaires being foisted on the American public. I didn't ask for AI, AI steals from my own intelligence non-consensually by scraping the writing and images I've produced over the years, and now may result in the death of beautiful natural spaces and the animals and other living beings they're home to? Fuck that. This is part of a wider land and marine spaces grab that is happening under the president and the Fish and Wildlife "Service" (who are you serving? What a joke) without the mandate of the people. You are selling off the public's belongings for short term gains that will not benefit the VAST majority of of US, only the already rich elite that you're just giving more property to for no reason other than continued personal gain. It's absolutely disgusting and I want no part of it, want those who supposedly represent me to have no part of it. You should honestly be ashamed for even considering it. GDP means nothing when the gross remains in the hands of only a few executives, and not in the public domain like these remaining wild spaces. $5000pp is no compensation for the riches that will be lost if you move ahead. I don't want your fucking blood money, I want you to use my taxes actually work for the people, and guess what? The people love whales and our public parks. NO TO THIS PROJECT.
